title: 第25章 你只能叫黄毛大王了第26章 是他是他就是他
slug: 西游开局获得太白金星传承
lines: 看到这些丹丸飞来，这些猴子们，包括四个老猴，都下意识用手接住。
一个个低头看着手里的丹丸，从没有闻到过如此浓郁的香气，简直直入灵魂深处。
这一刻，公猴子觉得绝美的母猴子都没有手里的丹丸吸引他们，母猴子亦然。
最终，这些猴子一个个按捺不住，纷纷将丹丸吞下。
丹丸在体内化为精纯的药力散开，让他们浑身一震，接着就是一股难以用言语形容的舒畅感席卷而来。
我欲成仙，快乐齐天！
这些猴子原本生活在花果山，日积月累之下，早已不是普通猴子可比。
如今再加上这丹丸，可谓是直接轰开了修行的大门。
只不过他们并没有修行法门，所以一时之间不知道如何操作。
四个老猴也是如此，不过他们身具特殊血脉，靠着本能倒是能勉强做到。
但本能这种东西，他们自己也无法解释，更别说传授给群猴了。
见状，叶云便为这群猴子讲了地仙以下的修行之道，以及玄水经地仙以下的法门。
此时，这群猴子只感觉如同打开了新世界的大门一样，原来这世上还有修行之道。
其中尤其以四个老猴收获最多，毕竟他们身具特殊血脉，资质悟性远比其他猴子高。
叶云传完之后，看着一个个陷入修炼状态的猴子们，心中有些疑惑。
按理说，这些猴子血脉之中会有传承记忆，就如同叶云的原身虎先锋，以及黄风岭的那些妖怪们。
血脉之中或多或少会传承一些记忆。
但从这群猴子的表现来看，根本没有，尤其是四个老猴，可是身具赤尻马猴和通臂猿猴的血脉，竟然也没有。
叶云猜测，应该是漫天仙佛防止猴哥从这些猴子的血脉记忆得到修行之法，所以出手将这些血脉记忆都抹去了。
毕竟，以猴哥的悟性和天赋，让他得到了修行之法，说不定自己摸索着修行，就不会想要出海去寻仙访道了。
不会寻仙访道，菩提祖师还怎么出场，佛教还怎么布局。
当然，这些只是猜测，具体如何还是那句话，等以后强大了再去探寻。
此时，这些猴子们依旧还处在修炼状态，叶云也没有去管他们，继续去炼制丹药服用，提升太白剑经的进度点。
没多久，叶云手里的天材地宝，加上从黑风山获得的，以及玉面公主送的，都被炼成丹药耗尽。
看了一眼面板，叶云心中暗道：“根据前面的经验来看，小成阶段应该是每隔九万进度点，提升一个层次。”
也就是说，他只需要再获得一万进度点，就能晋升真仙中期了。
“一万进度点，分分钟就能达到。”
叶云体会到了起飞的感觉，还得是花果山啊，换成黄风岭，天知道要苦修到什么时候，才能获得这么多的进度点。
好的丹药和好的修炼环境，可以加快苦修的速度，自然就能获得更多的进度点。
在这方面，花果山自然是吊打黄风岭周边的。
别看黄风岭在原剧情里被黄风大王黄毛貂鼠占据，就以为是什么好地方了。
其实是因为黄毛貂鼠自己厉害，跟黄风岭半毛钱关系没有。
那可是能偷吃灵山灯油，擅长三昧神风神通，有编制的妖怪。
原作里，能跟猴哥对战数十个回合不分胜负，更是施展三昧神风将猴哥的火眼金睛都吹的酸痛无比。
content_en:
Seeing these pills flying towards them, the monkeys, including the four old monkeys, subconsciously caught them with their hands.
One by one, they looked down at the pill pills in their hands. They had never smelled such a strong aroma before, it simply penetrated into the depths of their souls.
At this moment, the male monkey felt that the beautiful female monkey was not attracted by the pill in her hand, and the same was true for the female monkey.
In the end, these monkeys could no longer hold back and swallowed the pills one after another.
The pills turned into pure medicinal power and dispersed in their bodies, causing their whole bodies to tremble, followed by an indescribable sense of relief that swept over them.
I want to become a fairy and be happy!
These monkeys originally lived in Huaguo Mountain, but over time, they are no longer comparable to ordinary monkeys.
Now coupled with this pill, it can be said that the door to practice has been opened directly.
It's just that they didn't practice the method, so they didn't know how to operate it for a while.
The same is true for the four old monkeys, but they have special blood and can barely do it by relying on instinct.
But they can't explain things like instinct themselves, let alone teach it to a group of monkeys.
Seeing this, Ye Yun told the group of monkeys about the way of cultivation for people below the level of earthly immortals, as well as the method of Xuanshui Sutra for people below the level of earthly immortals.
At this time, these monkeys felt as if they had opened the door to a new world. It turned out that there was still a way to practice cultivation in this world.
Among them, the four old monkeys have gained the most. After all, they have special bloodline and their qualifications and understanding are much higher than other monkeys.
After Ye Yun finished teaching, he looked at the monkeys who were in a state of cultivation one by one, feeling a little confused in his heart.
It stands to reason that these monkeys will have inherited memories in their bloodline, just like Ye Yun's original Tiger Pioneer and the monsters in Huangfengling.
Some memories will be passed down more or less in the bloodline.
But judging from the performance of this group of monkeys, there is no such thing at all, especially the four old monkeys, but there is no such thing as the bloodline of the red-necked horse monkey and the thong-branched monkey.
Ye Yun guessed that the immortal Buddhas in the sky prevented Brother Monkey from obtaining the cultivation method from the bloodline memories of these monkeys, so he took action to erase all these bloodline memories.
After all, with Brother Monkey's understanding and talent, he has obtained the method of practice. Maybe if he practices practice by himself, he will not want to go out to sea to seek immortals and visit the Tao.
If you don’t know how to seek immortals and visit the Tao, how can Patriarch Bodhi appear, and how can Buddhism be organized?
Of course, these are just guesses. The exact details are still the same. We will explore them later when we become stronger.
At this time, these monkeys were still in a state of cultivation, and Ye Yun ignored them and continued to refine the elixirs and take them to increase the progress points of the Taibai Sword Sutra.
Not long after, the heavenly materials and earthly treasures in Ye Yun's hands, plus those obtained from Black Wind Mountain and those given by Princess Jade Face, were all used up in the elixirs.
[Taibai Sword Classic (Small Cheng 80000.36 million)]
After taking a look at the panel, Ye Yun thought to himself: "Based on previous experience, the completion stage should be one level every 90,000 progress points."
In other words, he only needs to obtain another 10,000 progress points to be promoted to the middle stage of True Immortal.
"Ten thousand progress points can be reached in minutes."
Ye Yun experienced the feeling of taking off. It had to be Huaguoshan. If it were Huangfengling, God knows how long it would take to get so many progress points.
Good elixirs and a good cultivation environment can speed up the pace of hard training and naturally gain more progress points.
In this regard, Huaguo Mountain naturally beats the surrounding areas of Huangfengling.
Even though Huang Fengling was occupied by the Yellow Wind King and the Yellow-haired Mink in the original plot, you might think it was a good place.
In fact, it's because the yellow-haired marten is very powerful and has nothing to do with Huang Fengling.
That is a well-organized monster who can steal lamp oil from Lingshan Mountain and is good at Samadhi divine wind and supernatural powers.
In the original work, he could fight Monkey Brother for dozens of rounds without deciding the outcome, and he even used Samadhi Kamikaze to blow out Monkey Brother's fiery eyes to the point of extreme pain.
